images.title: Read an Egyptian numeral by adding
images.purpose: Shows 3 lotuses, no coils, 4 heels and 6 strokes read as 3000 + 40 + 6 = 3046.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Four groups of symbols in a row with one empty dashed slot, a value under each group, and the total below.
images.exact_structure: Left to right with clear gaps: exactly 3 lotus flower symbols (amber #E69F00 fill, dark outline); then one empty dashed grey (#6B7280) box the size of one symbol; then exactly 4 heel symbols (upside down U shapes, teal #0072B2); then exactly 6 short vertical dark strokes. Under the lotuses 3000, under the empty box no coils, under the heels 40, under the strokes 6, all in small dark text. Below everything, centred, a rounded box with a teal outline containing 3046 in large dark text. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Add the value of every symbol; a missing landmark adds nothing.
images.description: Shows 3 lotuses, no coils, 4 heels and 6 strokes read as 3000 + 40 + 6 = 3046.
images.context: Worked example: 3 lotuses, 4 heels, 6 strokes is 3046.

image_decisions.why: Grouped symbols with values beneath make reading an Egyptian numeral a simple sum.
